**You can apply now to all open research grants that match a final‑year ENTC student with CGPA 8.2.**  

| Grant (code) | Title | Amount | Application opens | Deadline | Status |
|--------------|-------|--------|-------------------|----------|--------|
| GR‑IOT‑07 | Smart Campus IoT Research Grant | ₹80,000 | 01 Nov 2026 | 20 Jan 2027 | open [SQL] |
| GR‑5G‑15 | 5G and Next‑Gen Networks Fellowship | ₹1,10,000 | 01 Nov 2026 | 31 Jan 2027 | open [SQL] |
| GR‑VLSI‑09 | VLSI Design Research Fellowship | ₹1,20,000 | 20 Nov 2026 | 10 Feb 2027 | open [SQL] |
| GR‑SUS‑08 | Sustainability & Green Computing Grant | ₹70,000 | 01 Nov 2026 | 28 Feb 2027 | open [SQL] |
| GR‑ENT‑13 | Student Startup Seed Grant | ₹2,00,000 | 01 Nov 2026 | 01 Mar 2027 | open [SQL] |

**Eligibility** – Your CGPA 8.2 meets or exceeds every grant’s minimum (≥ 7.5 for GR‑ENT‑13; ≥ 8.0 for the others) as required in the Research Grant Policy 2026‑27 §3 (e.g., GR‑5G‑15 ≥ 8.0 [Doc: Research Grant Policy 2026‑27 §3 Grant‑specific eligibility > GR‑5G‑15]) and you are in Year 4 of ENTC, which is an eligible year for all listed grants.  

**Note:** A student may hold at most **two** research grants simultaneously (General rule §2‑3) and must submit the application before each deadline (General rule §2‑4).  

Closed grants (GR‑HW‑06, GR‑ROB‑12) are no longer accepting applications.
sql: SELECT grant_code, title, amount, application_open, application_deadline, status FROM grants WHERE grant_code = ANY(ARRAY['GR-ENT-13', 'GR-5G-15', 'GR-VLSI-09', 'GR-SUS-08', 'GR-HW-06', 'GR-IOT-07', 'GR-ROB-12']) ORDER BY application_deadline
